name: Home
short_desc: Smart-home hub for the Home apps: devices, rooms, rules, energy, door and cameras.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: Hub for the Home apps (iOS, watchOS, Android, Wear OS, desktop) and the web app it serves at its own address: talks to the devices in the home network (Shellys first), keeps rooms, people and rights, runs scenes and rules, records history and energy, rings the phones when someone is at the door. Expose it on its domain; the apps and the Shellys connect there.

form_fields.label: Address of this server for the phones
form_fields.hint: The LAN address (or VPN address) the phones reach this server on, for live video and talk at the door on port 8557 (TCP and UDP).

form_fields.label: Home network
form_fields.hint: The home network (at most a /22): the hub searches it for Shellys, listed in the app to import or ignore, and a phone there counts as at home when its person shares that (rules on arriving and leaving). You can change it in the app too.

form_fields.label: Shellys to import (optional)
form_fields.hint: Addresses of Shellys to import as soon as they are found, comma-separated. With neither this nor the home network, the hub shows a simulated flat.

form_fields.label: Backup key (optional)
form_fields.hint: An age public key the hub encrypts its nightly snapshots to. You can set it in the app (Setup › Hub) instead; the private key stays with you, never on the server.

form_fields.label: APNs key id
form_fields.hint: iPhone pushes. The .p8 key itself goes into the data folder as apns-key.p8, see the description.

form_fields.label: Apple team id
form_fields.hint: iPhone pushes, together with the APNs key id.

form_fields.label: ntfy server for Android pushes
form_fields.hint: Optional. The ntfy server the Android phones get rings through (UnifiedPush). The hub sends only to endpoints on this server; the address alone is enough when the server lets anyone write to the up* topics.

form_fields.label: ntfy token for Android pushes
form_fields.hint: Optional, only for an ntfy server with access control: a token of an ntfy user that may write to the UnifiedPush topics (up*). Or allow it on the server: ntfy access everyone 'up*' write-only.
